purpose: Describe share-count filing metadata; no prices, rankings or returns
method: Join sub.tsv to num.tsv on accession. Select form exactly 10-K or 10-Q and facts named EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding with qtrs=0, uom=shares and empty coreg. Count distinct accessions having at least one row with dimn=0 or dimn other than 0. Do not filter by fact date, numeric value, version, freshness or dimension meaning. Overlap is possible.

ticker_hash_join.method: For the 940 dimensional-only accessions, collect distinct dimh values from selected num.tsv share facts. Match each to nonempty TradingSymbol rows in txt.tsv on exact accession and dimh; ignore fact and symbol dates and versions.
ticker_hash_join.limitation: Exact dimension-hash equality is a structural lead, not proof of share-class identity or public availability. A mismatch does not prove that a correct mapping is impossible or that a ticker is missing.

verification: Separate csv.DictReader passes reproduced the accession totals and the ticker-join any/all counts. All passes used the same archive and were performed by the same analyst; this is not independent source validation. The no-match count is 940 minus 288.
limitations: A quarterly filing archive is not a dated, complete stock or listing universe; one issuer can have multiple filings.
Presence of a fact does not establish the date, availability, freshness, correctness, positivity, class identity or completeness of any share count.
Dimensional facts may reflect axes other than share class; this count does not establish that all are useful class-specific counts.
The archive rounds ddate to a month end. Filing date and acceptance do not by themselves establish the timestamp at which a fact became public.
